title: S08T05 - Add CI and IDE status surfaces and make an explicit TUI ship/defer decision
description: Provide machine-consumable CI checks and lightweight editor status while either shipping a tested minimal TUI or clearly removing it from the public stable promise.
acceptanceCriteria: CI can publish closeout, review, spec, sync, and health status with stable annotations and no hidden mutation.
The TUI is either supported with parity tests for its declared routes or labeled experimental and excluded from stable release claims.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
